tools.name: accredible_get_issuer
tools.description: The Accredible issuer (organization) behind the API key: id, name, e-mail, remaining credential credits (certificate_left), language and URL. Good first call. GET /v1/issuer/details.

tools.name: accredible_search_credentials
tools.description: Search issued credentials (badges and certificates) with filters that combine with AND, newest first by default. Returns id, uuid, encoded_id, recipient name/e-mail, group, issued_on, expired_on, published state (approve), whether the recipient opened or engaged, and meta. Paging: size + offset (fir

tools.name: accredible_get_credential
tools.description: One credential in full: recipient, group, issue and expiry dates, published state, public URL, evidence items, references, custom attributes and skills. The id is the numeric credential id or the custom id your organization set. GET /v1/credentials/{id}.

tools.name: accredible_get_credential_analytics
tools.description: The analytics events of one credential (recipient views, shares, privacy changes, verification and so on) with timestamps. Read-only despite being a POST. POST /v1/credentials/analytics/{id}.

tools.name: accredible_list_analytics
tools.description: Account-wide credential analytics events (views, shares, downloads and similar), optionally for a date range, group or department. Paged (default 100 per page). GET /v1/analytics.

tools.name: accredible_search_groups
tools.description: Search groups (an achievement such as a course or qualification that credentials belong to). Filters combine with AND; name and course_name match partially. Returns id, name, course name and description, design ids, language and dates. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/issuer/groups/searc

tools.name: accredible_get_group
tools.description: One group in full: name, course name and description, learning outcomes, design ids, language, skills and dates. GET /v1/issuer/groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: accredible_search_designs
tools.description: List badge and certificate designs, optionally by kind or meta_data. POST /v1/designs/search (a read-only search).

tools.name: accredible_get_design
tools.description: One badge or certificate design with its settings. GET /v1/designs/{design_id}.

tools.name: accredible_search_departments
tools.description: List departments (independent organization units with their own designs, groups and branding). An account-wide key sees all, a department key only its own. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/departments/search (a read-only search).

tools.name: accredible_get_department
tools.description: One department: name, description, URL, branding and meta_data. GET /v1/departments/{department_id}.

tools.name: accredible_search_collections
tools.description: List collections (sets of groups shown together). Filters: ids, name (substring), public. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/collections/search (a read-only search).

tools.name: accredible_search_attribute_keys
tools.description: List the custom attribute keys (placeholders such as a grade or date that credential designs and e-mails merge in); useful to know which custom_attributes a credential can carry. Paged: pass meta.next_page as page. POST /v1/attribute_keys/search (a read-only search).

tools.name: accredible_list_skill_frameworks
tools.description: The skills frameworks (O*NET, ESCO, NACE or your own) enabled for a department, each with its published versions. Needs a plan that includes skills frameworks (otherwise HTTP 403 plan_not_entitled). Paged, max 10 per page. GET /v1/skill_frameworks.

tools.name: accredible_search_skills
tools.description: Search the skills of one published skills-framework version by name or the publisher's identifier (partial, case-insensitive, at least 2 characters). Paged, max 50 per page. GET /v1/skill_frameworks/{id}/versions/{version_id}/skills.

tools.name: accredible_list_data_exports
tools.description: Data exports of the departments the key can access: department, status (scheduled, processing, completed, errored) and download links of completed files. Exports are created in the Accredible Dashboard. GET /v1/data_exports.

tools.name: accredible_get_data_export
tools.description: One data export: department, status and, once completed, the download links of its files. GET /v1/data_exports/{id}.

tools.name: accredible_get_team_member
tools.description: One team member of the account: name, e-mail and permissions per department. Which members are visible depends on the key (an account-wide key sees all, a department key its own department). GET /v1/team_members/{id}.

tools.name: accredible_issue_credential
tools.description: WRITE: creates ONE credential (badge or certificate) for ONE recipient in an existing group. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: accredible_get_issuer, accredible_search_credentials, accredible_get_credential, accredible_get_credential_analytics, accredible_search_groups, accredible_search_designs, accredible_search_departments, accredible_get_department, accredible_search_collections, accredible_search_attribute_keys · Private data: accredible_get_issuer, accredible_search_credentials, accredible_get_credential, accredible_get_credential_analytics, accredible_list_analytics, accredible_search_groups, accredible_search_attribute_keys, accredible_list_data_exports, accredible_get_data_export, accredible_issue_credential · Public sink: accredible_search_credentials, accredible_get_credential_analytics, accredible_search_groups, accredible_search_designs, accredible_search_departments, accredible_search_collections, accredible_search_attribute_keys, accredible_issue_credential.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: accredible_get_issuer, accredible_search_credentials, accredible_get_credential, accredible_get_credential_analytics, accredible_search_groups, accredible_search_designs, accredible_search_departments, accredible_get_department, accredible_search_collections, accredible_search_attribute_keys · Private data: accredible_get_issuer, accredible_search_credentials, accredible_get_credential, accredible_get_credential_analytics, accredible_list_analytics, accredible_search_groups, accredible_search_attribute_keys, accredible_list_data_exports, accredible_get_data_export, accredible_issue_credential · Public sink: accredible_search_credentials, accredible_get_credential_analytics, accredible_search_groups, accredible_search_designs, accredible_search_departments, accredible_search_collections, accredible_search_attribute_keys, accredible_issue_credential

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
